reason: My customers already come to me through my weekend Facebook lives, and I only decide on a sale a day or two before, so I'd never get a sender name approved and a list ready in time. SMS is a channel I don't use, so I'd be paying to learn something new right before a sale.
objection: Credits that expire in 3 months. I'd only send for a sale or two, so most of a package would just die, and even 0.58 a message adds up across my whole list when a Facebook post costs me nothing.
would_change_my_mind: If I could send a sale blast the same day I sign up, from a list I paste in, and pay only for that one blast with no expiry worry, and see it bring more people to my shop than a Facebook live does.
